why: Abilities: apply the recorded background increases {"ability:cha": 2, "ability:wis": 1}, then the ASIs at levels 4, 8, 12, 16, capping each score at 20. Modifiers are floor((score − 10)/2). Proficiency bonus is +6 at level 17 (PHB ch. 2, Determine Ability Scores and Character Advancement; ch. 4, the chosen background; ch. 5, Ability Score Improvement).

HP: 6 + 16×4 + 17×3 + 17 (Draconic Resilience) = 138. Constitution increases apply to every attained level (PHB ch. 2, Level Advancement and Fixed Hit Points by Class; ch. 3, class features; ch. 4, species; ch. 5, Tough when present).
AC and initiative: Draconic Resilience 10 + Dexterity 2 + Charisma 5 = 17; initiative +2 (PHB ch. 1, Armor Class and Initiative; ch. 3, class features; ch. 5, Alert when present; ch. 6, Armor).

Saves add proficiency +6 in Constitution and Charisma; otherwise use the ability modifier. Skill proficiencies: Insight and Religion (Acolyte), and Arcana and Deception (Sorcerer). Add the usual ability modifier and proficiency +6, or use the modifier alone (PHB ch. 2, Fill In Numbers; ch. 3, Core Traits; ch. 4, origins; ch. 5, Skilled when present).

Spellcasting: DC 19 = 8 + proficiency 6 + casting modifier 5; attack +11 = 6 + 5. The level 17 class table gives 19 class preparations and 6 class cantrips and slots [4, 3, 3, 3, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1]. Always-prepared feature spells are additional (PHB ch. 3, class Features table and Spellcasting or Pact Magic).

Sorcery Points 17; Innate Sorcery 2; Sorcerous Restoration 1 per Long Rest; Elemental Affinity can add Charisma to one damage roll per spell; Dragon Wings 1 per Long Rest before spending Sorcery Points (Sorcerer and Draconic Sorcery). Sources: PHB ch. 3 and ch. 4, the named features.

Weapon attacks add the permitted ability modifier and proficiency +6 to hit, and the same ability modifier to weapon damage. Finesse permits Dexterity; ranged weapons use Dexterity. The normal Unarmed Strike deals 1 + Strength, with proficiency on its attack. Optional, conditional, and two-handed alternatives require their own conditions (PHB ch. 1, Making an Attack; ch. 6, Weapons; Rules Glossary, Unarmed Strike).
